messages:
sam: quick sketch — we should add a tenant prioritization scheduler sitting in the query gateway. goal: honor dashboard SLOs for high-tier customers while keeping best-effort for free tier. thoughts?

lina: sgtm as a high level. we need clear invariants: max latency per tier, soft vs hard caps, and graceful degradation order.

marta: agree. also: how do we map RBAC -> priority? enterprise accounts get high priority, but user-level roles inside an enterprise probably not. we should avoid per-user hot loops.

devin: sketch idea: a two-stage scheduler — admission + shaping. admission does fast checks (tier, tokens left, tenant health), shaping applies per-connection rate and batching weight.

sam: exactly. admission should be O(1) checks, no network calls. shaping can be token-bucket with dynamic weights from telemetry.

pradeep: telemetry-driven weights is nice but watch feedback loops. if we boost weight when latency rises it can amplify load. prefer a slight under-provisioning then slow ramp.

lina: +1. we can compute weights periodically (1s) from a moving window and clamp deltas.

marta: what about RBAC and multiple roles? proposal: compute tenant_priority = base_tier_priority + role_bonus (capped). role_bonus only applies for owner/infra roles, not for normal product users.

sam: implementation note: do NOT call authz service on the hot path. materialize minimal token with baked-in tier and role bitmask at the gateway when the session starts. refresh async.

devin: pseudo-config for scheduler (will refine):
```
priority_buckets: ["gold","silver","bronze","free"]
base_weights: {"gold":10, "silver":5, "bronze":2, "free":1}
role_bonus: {"owner":3, "ops":2}
max_inflight_per_tenant: 50
admission_timeout_ms: 8
weight_recalc_window_ms: 1000
weight_delta_clamp: 0.2
```

pradeep: looks good. also add an emergency-fallback flag: when overall cluster overload > 85% force strict tail-drop for free bucket, and enable degraded responses for non-critical dashboards.

marta: how do we surface this in Console? ops people want per-tenant realtime view + an override toggle for support.

sam: Console integration: a read-only panel for flows + a support toggle that issues a scoped ephemeral override token (expires 5m). override should be audited.

lina: observability: surface token-level latency percentiles, queue depth per bucket, weight history, and last auth refresh. set alerts for weight oscillation and admission-timeouts.

devin: concurrency concerns: scheduler state will be sharded by tenant-hash. losing a node should rehydrate quickly — store ephemeral weights in local cache with short TTL, recover from central telemetry store asynchronously.

pradeep: on consistency: make admission decisions tolerant to slightly stale weight. prefer availability.

ops-bot: loadtest started on staging: tenant-mix=1000:5000:20000:50000 (gold:silver:bronze:free) — ETA 20m

marta: perfect, we'll watch the control plane metrics. can someone add a canary policy that forces a single gold tenant to use a low weight to verify fairness?

sam: i'll add a canary param. final question: rollout plan? my suggestion: feature-flag behind gate, enable on staging -> 1% prod -> 10% prod with gradual telemetry checks -> full.

lina: add an automated rollback when error budget burn > 5% in 10m.

devin: I'll prototype admission/shaping lib this week, will post a tiny PR with the config and a fake telemetry source.

pradeep: checklist for RFC-followup: update runbook (fallback modes), Console UI mockups for override, telemetry schema change (add weight history), and security review for override tokens.

sam: awesome. thanks everyone. keeping this thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
